Guidance & outlook: Real GDP growth was estimated at 7.7% in FY 26 compared with 6.5% in FY 25.
India's ultra- high-net-worth population is expected to increase 27% to 25,217 individuals by 2031 from 19,877 in early FY 26.

REVIEW OF FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE Consolidated Performance (H lakh) Particulars FY 2025-26 FY 2024-25 Revenue (₹ lakhs) 13,798 8,940 PAT including OCI (₹ lakhs) 3,945 5,065 The consolidated financial result disclose growth of 54.34 % over the previous year..
Growth & demand: Demand for wealth management services could nearly double from US$1.1 trillion in FY 24 to US$2.3 trillion by FY 29, creating a sizable growth opportunity for advisory-led firms.
Assets under management and advice reached approximately ₹3,500 cr, while revenue increased to ₹21.48 cr from ₹5.38 cr in the inaugural year.
₹1,676 lakh from the Company, key team members and directors of Prime Group, by way of issue of 96,63,000 equity shares of PTWL, to support the continued growth and expansion of the business.
Margins & costs: Consolidated EBITDA stood at ₹19.61 cr compared with ₹38.79 cr.

When a business moves from zero to more than 850 clients and approximately ₹3,500 cr of assets under management and advice in its first full year, the cost base necessarily runs ahead of the eventual revenue maturity.
Inflation remained benign, with full-year CPI estimated at 2.1%, while cumulative rate cuts of 125 basis points supported consumption and investment.
Capex & expansion: During the year, we acquired a 97.83% stake in Prime Advisory Partners Limited in the United Kingdom and capitalised PRAL Management Consultancies LLC in Dubai.
Sun- Apollo was a USD 630 million FDI fund, one of the largest offshore fund of its vintage raised for opportunistic investing in Indian Real Estate..

The consolidated revenue comprised Investment Banking and Advisory Fees of ₹4,367 lakh, Corporate Advisory Fees of ₹7,699 lakh, Brokerage and Commission Income of ₹702 lakh, Dividend, Interest and Other Investment Income of ₹276 lakh, Net Gain on Fair Value Changes of ₹627 lakh, and Other Income of ₹128 lakh.
Balance sheet & cash: The company provides strategic support across a broad spectrum of areas, including financial planning, fundraising, mergers and acquisitions, private equity, debt placements, public issues, corporate advisory, and capital restructuring.
The Board also did not recommend a dividend for FY 26.

DIVIDEND AND RESERVES In order to conserve the Company's financial resources to support its strategic growth initiatives, expansion into new business activities and future capital requirements, the Board of Directors has decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Risks & challenges: 18 | Prime Securities Limited The health of the banking system also improved, with gross non-performing assets declining to a multi- decadal low of 1.8% as of March 2026.

ECONOMIC OVERVIEW FY 2025-26 was characterised by resilience in the Indian economy despite a challenging global macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical uncertainties, inflationary pressures in certain regions, fluctuating interest rate expectations and volatility in global financial markets.

RISK MANAGEMENT FRAMEWORK The Board has established a comprehensive Risk Management Framework designed to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate key strategic, operational, financial, compliance and reputational risks.
